localAI.report.generate.zh-Hans: 生成本机 AI 报告

localAI.report.generating.en: Loading and generating on this device…

localAI.report.explanation.en: Only this button runs the model. Your records stay on your device.
localAI.report.explanation.zh-Hans: 仅点击生成时运行模型，记录留在你的设备上。

localAI.report.disabled.en: On-device AI is off. You can enable it in Settings; rule reports remain available.
localAI.report.disabled.zh-Hans: 本机 AI 已关闭，可在设置中开启；规则报告仍可使用。

localAI.report.fallback.en: The on-device report could not be completed. A rule report is shown; you can try again.
localAI.report.fallback.zh-Hans: 本机报告未能完成，已展示规则报告，你可以稍后重试。

localAI.report.source.en: Selected on this device by Qwen3 0.6B · Values and advice verified by local rules
localAI.report.source.zh-Hans: Qwen3 0.6B 在本机挑选 · 数值与建议由本地规则校验

localAI.history.deleteConfirm.en: Delete this saved report? Your original records will remain.
localAI.history.deleteConfirm.zh-Hans: 删除这份历史报告？原始记录将保留。

localAI.history.deleteFailed.en: Report deletion failed. Please try again.
